# François Fournier — Fractional CTO

> A tech decision left pending costs more than the decision itself.
> Fractional CTO: a few days a month to diagnose the situation, make the
> call with you, and structure what comes next.

Twenty-five years building, researching and leading — researcher, software
engineer, manager, entrepreneur. Specialising in the R&D → production
transition for software, data and AI systems.

Publisher: MayetCo SAS, SIREN 920330420, France.
